{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The I-C2 is used by local governments on lower-tech worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. I hear that VLS is setting trade concessions up with these lesser-developed planets. By giving the locals a few of the I-C2s, VLS can build factories and start signing up contract labor.|Bublin|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
'''Bublin''' was an independent [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who learned that [[Veril Line Systems/Legends|Veril Line Systems]] was providing trade concessions for the purchase of [[I-C2 Civil-Industrial Droid/Legends|I-C2 construction droids]] to underdeveloped worlds. Bublin learned that VLS provided the [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droids]] in return for the right to build new [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in the reconstructed [[City/Legends|cities]].
